title: Pointwise codimension-one ramification criterion for a flat quasi-finite morphism
statement: Let $X,Y$ be locally Noetherian schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type and flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and quasi-finite at $x\in X$ [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Suppose $0<\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. For each $x′$ specializing to $x$ with $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x′}=1$, assume an open neighbourhood $V$ of $x′$ on which $V\to Y$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. Then there exists an open neighbourhood of $x$ on which $f$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

proof.text: Positive stalk dimension excludes a generic point of an irreducible component. The supplied formally unramified neighbourhoods and local finite type give the unramifiedness hypotheses of Tag 0BJH.

Work etale locally at x and its image to obtain a finite flat morphism with x the sole point over its image. Local dimension, flatness and unramifiedness are preserved, and etaleness descends. The finite flat morphism is finite locally free. Its discriminant defines a locally principal branch locus. If the image of x belongs to this locus, positive source dimension and equality of source and target local dimensions allow Tag 0BJG to supply a dimension-one generalization in the branch locus. Choose a ramified point over it. Closedness of the finite morphism and the singleton fibre imply that this point specializes to x. Equality of local dimensions makes its dimension one, contrary to the assumed unramified neighbourhood. Hence f is etale at x; openness of the etale locus supplies the desired source neighbourhood.

theorem exists_etale_neighbourhood_of_flat_of_quasiFiniteAt_of_codimension_one
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Flat f] (x : X)
    (hq : f.QuasiFiniteAt x)
    (hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hunram : ∀ x' : X, Specializes x' x →
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x') = 1 →
      ∃ V : X.Opens, x' ∈ V ∧ FormallyUnramified (V.ι ≫ f)) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ f)
